games.name: [-44% VIP] Petak Umpet
games.desc:
🏡 Petak Umpet: Village Edition brings Indonesia’s traditional hide-and-seek game to life! Explore villages inspired by Indonesian culture, outsmart your opponents, and race to escape!

🌿 AS A HIDER
Find interactive hiding spots, throw pebbles to distract Seekers, and use your abilities to stay one step ahead. Work together to activate 5 signals and unlock the escape pole early—or survive until it opens in the final 30 seconds!

🕵️ AS A SEEKER
Search the village, check hiding spots, and follow suspicious sounds. In Normal mode, sabotage an activated signal to briefly reveal Hider locations. Stop everyone from escaping!

🦠 INFECTION MODE
Caught Hiders become Seekers! Join the hunt or survive as the village fills with pursuers.

🐔 Watch your step—running near chickens might give away your position!
✨ Enjoy emotes, spectating, and controls for PC and mobile. Taking a break? Turn on AFK to skip the next round!

games.name: [BIG UPDATE] Mancing Indo
games.desc:
🌊 Welcome to Mancing Indo! 🌊

Experience the ultimate fishing adventure inspired by the marine life of Indonesia! 🇮🇩 Cast your line to catch local fish, sail traditional boats, and explore beautiful islands.

🌴 EXPLORE: Sail to Boomerang Island, Thousand Islands, Crab King Island & Bagang Luar! 
🐟 CATCH: Reel in 40+ realistic fish, from Kakap Merah to Marlin Hitam & Tuna Gigi Anjing! 
⛵ SAIL: Drive authentic Indonesian fishing boats. 

[🎣 How To Fish: Classic] 
• Equip rod and click/hold to cast.
• Wait for a bite & watch the bobber.
• Click and hold to reel in your catch!
• PC: Hold the 'E' key to reel in
• Sell fish to upgrade gear & buy boats.

[🏆 How To Fish: Galatama] 
• Equip Galatama rod and wait for a strike.
• Mobile/Console: Rotate the reel clockwise to pull.
• PC: Hold the 'E' key to reel in!
• ⚠️ TENSION: When the fish struggles, STOP reeling immediately or it will escape! Wait for the fish to calm down, then continue to reel.
